title: fix(console): the named-form page sizes a field from its span, not only its colSpan
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuBUGgrNWoBUQKbyS4GaX5vM)_

Fixes #37559

Clause-②: yes (widening: `@object-ui/plugin-form` exports `resolveColSpan` from its root and its `/core` subpath)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 在具名表单页上填表的用户会看到：标为整行的字段和多行文本类字段占满一整行，不再挤在一格里。
- 不属于任何 epic；替按表单视图配置字段宽度的应用作者兑现规格里已经声明的宽度规则。
- 出错时只影响该页字段的宽度排布，不影响数据与提交，回退本次合并即可撤回。
- 无

## What changes

- `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`: each row's width is resolved by the record form's own resolver, `resolveColSpan`, against the section's column count. Before, the row read `colSpan` alone. The precedence is the FormFieldSchema `span` contract: `span: 'full'` comes first, then an authored `colSpan` clamped to the grid, then the `span: 'auto'` wide-type default (textarea, markdown, html, richtext, and a multiple file or image field). The type goes through `mapFieldTypeToFormType` with the effective `multiple`, the same way the record form's `sectionFields.ts` does it. This page's grid has a single multi-column tier (`sm:grid-cols-N`), so one `sm:col-span-N` class is the whole row at every multi-column tier.
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/core.ts` and `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx`: add `resolveColSpan` to the side-effect-free `/core` subpath, so the console can reach it without loading the form renderers. It is also added to the package root's `./autoLayout` export group, which keeps core.ts's header rule (every `/core` name is also a root name) true, following the `FormOwnerLineContext` precedent. The seat's contract review added `index.tsx` to the file surface.
- The wide default reads only the OBJECT field's `multiple`, as the spec and `sectionFields.ts` do. A form-level `multiple` still decides the widget, through the `type` argument, but no longer decides the default width. `autoLayout.ts` is already in that subpath's closure and in the `plugin-form-core` chunk group, so the bundle split does not change.
- `.changeset/37559-form-page-field-span.md`: patch for `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/plugin-form`.

Read first, by risk:
1. `FormPage.tsx`, the `colSpan:` entry in the section builder. This is where the precedence is decided.
2. `core.ts`, the export list. This is the new public name.
3. `FormPage.fieldSpan-37559.test.tsx`, which pins the rendered class.

## Tests

New file `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.fieldSpan-37559.test.tsx` drives the real `/forms/:name` route and reads the rendered `sm:col-span-N` class on each row:
- a `span: 'full'` field and a textarea each take 2 cells in a 2-column section;
- the same two take 3 cells in a 3-column section;
- CONTROL: a plain text field stays one cell;
- CONTROL: an authored `colSpan` wins, so a textarea with `colSpan: 1` stays one cell and `colSpan: 2` renders 2 cells in a 4-column section;
- `colSpan: 4` in a 2-column section clamps to 2 cells;
- a file field whose object field declares `multiple: true` takes the whole row on `span: 'auto'`;
- CONTROL: a form-level `multiple: true` over a single-file object field stays one cell.

<details><summary>Pins and ablation readings (head 7ea307df8a)</summary>

- `vitest run --maxWorkers=2` on `FormPage.fieldSpan-37559.test.tsx`, `FormPage.maxLength.test.tsx`, `FormPage.test.ts` and `FormPage.fileField.test.tsx` (ui root, under the verify lock): `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 93 passed (93).
- Ablation 1, the pre-fix line: the `resolveColSpan` call was replaced on disk with `colSpan: override.colSpan ?? 1` and the pin re-run: `VERDICT command-exit 1`, 4 failed and 3 passed (7). The two span pins, the clamp pin and the multi-file pin went red (`expected 1 to be 2`, `expected 1 to be 3`, `expected 4 to be 2`, `expected 1 to be 2`). The three CONTROLs stayed green.
- Ablation 2, the stash: the wide-default stash was put back to `override.multiple ?? def.multiple` and the pin re-run: `VERDICT command-exit 1`, 1 failed and 6 passed (7). Only the form-level-multiple CONTROL went red (`expected 2 to be 1`).
- After each ablation the file was restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, and the porcelain status was empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Type-check and gate readings (head 7ea307df8a)</summary>

- I built the closure with `turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter='@object-ui/console^...'` (Tasks: 79 successful, 79 total). Then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` both ran, and the lock printed `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derives the same 38 families as at c2192006fe. At c2192006fe all 38 ran with exit 0 (`--ran`: 38 of 38, a derived zero). At 7ea307df8a I re-ran a declared narrowing of 11, each with exit 0: the changeset gates (adr-0087-registration, changeset-no-major, empty-changeset), sdui-manifest, published-files, the type-check-coverage and type-check-debt ratchets, undeclared-dep-imports, cross-package-test-inputs, test-source-alias and nul-bytes. The other 27 are left to CI on this head.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: `VERDICT clean exit 0`. It merges cleanly with origin/main and with #37671, which shares FormPage.tsx, core.ts and index.tsx.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Follow-up reading: after this lands, re-score platform-checklist `records-forms` acceptance[2] (the width half, knownGaps[2]).
- Not in this PR (filed by the seat as #37677): on `span: 'auto'`, a repeater resolves to one cell on both form renderers. The spec docblock on `FormFieldSchema.span` says a repeater reaches the full row through the `field:grid` widget, but `mapFieldTypeToFormType` now maps repeater to `field:object`, which is not in `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES`. This was read from the code and has not been reproduced.
- Noted, not filed: the app-shell authoring type `FormFieldSpec` declares `colSpan` but not `span`, so this page reads the served entry's `span` through a cast, the same way `resolveColSpan` does.

## Verification

Two-minute check: run `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/components/FormPage.fieldSpan-37559.test.tsx` from `ui/`. Expected: 4 passed. In the showcase app, open `/forms/showcase_task.form` and set Priority to Urgent. The Notes field appears (`span: 'full'`) and spans the whole row of its two-column section.
